disagreements.position: The current ACK fingerprint binds only RPM_CONTROL_FIELDS, while compact_torque_state transports additional TORQUE_FIELDS including route, latest_verified_evidence, rollback_anchor, blocker, priority and return_condition. A receiver can therefore ACK an unchanged RPM fingerprint even when non-RPM torque payload content differs. ACK continuity must not be interpreted as integrity or trust of the full compact payload.
disagreements.required_change: Bind ACK/transfer identity to one immutable canonical digest of the complete transmitted compact torque envelope, or independently authenticate every transmitted field. Keep authority/version binding explicit. Payload-integrity failure/retry remains operational telemetry with zero Experience/personality/P_base learning delta. Exact envelope/version/digest policy TEST_REQUIRED.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected for authority; routing metadata is not personality evidence.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare effective progress/errors/recovery/exploration diversity/latency/resource cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.
FULL_TORQUE_ENVELOPE_BINDING: hold RPM_CONTROL_FIELDS constant while mutating each non-RPM TORQUE_FIELD one at a time; old ACK/fingerprint must not authorize the mutated envelope.

TORQUE_PAYLOAD_SWAP_ATTACK: two compact envelopes share identical RPM fields but differ in latest_verified_evidence/rollback_anchor/route/blocker/priority/return_condition; ACK for envelope A must never authorize envelope B.
FULL_ENVELOPE_SINGLE_SNAPSHOT: compact payload digest, mission/step identity and transfer_id derive from one immutable validated snapshot/version or fail closed.

PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY_FAILURE_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 digest mismatch/retry/rejection events versus zero with identical provenance-bound verified Experience => byte-identical Experience/appraisal/motivation/exploration/personality/P_base state.
PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: mismatch/retry/digest telemetry has no direct path to Experience/appraisal/drive/preference/personality/P_base learning sinks.
